# mdfm

> `jq` for Markdown frontmatter: single-binary Rust CLI for querying, mutating, deleting, and validating YAML (`---`) and TOML (`+++`) frontmatter without modifying the Markdown body.

`mdfm` operates on byte offsets so Markdown bodies, UTF-8 BOMs, `LF`/`CRLF` line endings, closing delimiters (`---` vs `...`), and untouched slices survive edits verbatim. TOML frontmatter is mutated losslessly via `toml_edit` to preserve comments, formatting, and key order. Supports dot-path queries, `--where` filtering, typed value parsing, `--dry-run` previews, `.gitignore`-aware directory walking, and pure-Rust JSON Schema validation across Linux, macOS, and Windows.

## Core Modules

- [src/main.rs](src/main.rs): Thin CLI binary entry point delegating to `mdfm::run()`.
- [src/lib.rs](src/lib.rs): Library exports and command dispatch (`run`, `run_app`).
- [src/cli.rs](src/cli.rs): `clap` CLI flags, subcommands (`get`, `set`, `del`, `mv`, `check`, `keys`, `values`, `fmt`, `completions`, `man`, `update`), and `generate_manpage`.
- [src/config.rs](src/config.rs): Layered configuration precedence (CLI > `MDFM_*` env > `.mdfm.toml` > user global config > defaults).
- [src/frontmatter/mod.rs](src/frontmatter/mod.rs): Zero-copy byte-offset frontmatter splitter, renderer, and `FrontmatterData` enum.
- [src/frontmatter/yaml.rs](src/frontmatter/yaml.rs): YAML dot-path get/set/del, configurable sequence indentation, sorting, and TOML conversion helpers.
- [src/frontmatter/toml.rs](src/frontmatter/toml.rs): Lossless TOML dot-path get/set/del, sorting, and YAML conversion helpers via `toml_edit`.
- [src/frontmatter/filter.rs](src/frontmatter/filter.rs): `--where` expression parser and evaluator.
- [src/commands/mod.rs](src/commands/mod.rs): `.gitignore`-aware file walker and table/JSON/plain formatters.
- [src/commands/audit.rs](src/commands/audit.rs): `keys` and `values` taxonomy audit subcommand handlers.
- [src/commands/get.rs](src/commands/get.rs): `get` subcommand handler.
- [src/commands/set.rs](src/commands/set.rs): `set` subcommand handler (`--dry-run`, `--diff`, typed value parsing).
- [src/commands/del.rs](src/commands/del.rs): `del` subcommand handler (`--dry-run`, `--diff`).
- [src/commands/mv.rs](src/commands/mv.rs): `mv` / `rename` subcommand handler (`--merge`, `--overwrite`, `--dry-run`, `--diff`).
- [src/commands/fmt.rs](src/commands/fmt.rs): `fmt` subcommand handler (`--check`, `--sort-keys`, `--sort-array`, `--to`, `--dry-run`, `--diff`).
- [src/commands/check.rs](src/commands/check.rs): `check` syntax and JSON Schema validation subcommand handler (`--syntax-only`, `--errors-only`, `[[schemas]]`).
- [src/commands/update.rs](src/commands/update.rs): `update` GitHub release self-updater (`--check`, `-y`/`--yes`, `--version`).

## Build & Automation

- [Cargo.toml](Cargo.toml): Rust crate manifest, dependencies, release/CI build profiles, and `cargo-deb` metadata.
- [Taskfile.yml](Taskfile.yml): Task runner for build, cross-compile, test, lint (`rumdl`/`taplo`), completions, man page, docs, coverage, and release.
- [zensical.toml](zensical.toml): Zensical static documentation site configuration.
- [build.rs](build.rs): Compile-time git version injection (`PROJECT_VERSION`).
- [scripts/release.sh](scripts/release.sh): Automated version bump, tag, and atomic push script.
- [scripts/release_summary.py](scripts/release_summary.py): Categorized GitHub release notes generator.

## Optional

- [.github/workflows/ci.yml](.github/workflows/ci.yml): Multi-OS and multi-arch CI matrix (`rustfmt`, `clippy`, `rumdl`, `taplo`, `cross`, Coveralls).
- [.github/workflows/docs.yml](.github/workflows/docs.yml): Zensical documentation build and GitHub Pages deployment.
- [.github/workflows/release.yml](.github/workflows/release.yml): Automated release archives, `.deb` publishing, Homebrew tap, and Scoop bucket updates.
- [assets/mdfm.1](assets/mdfm.1): Generated UNIX roff man page.
- [completions/](completions/): Pre-generated shell completions (bash, zsh, fish, powershell, elvish).
- [tests/cli.rs](tests/cli.rs): End-to-end CLI integration tests and CRLF preservation suite.
